name: containers-cli
description: Containers skill toolbox, split by job rather than by binary: dockerfile translates a project's declared environment into a Dockerfile and refuses when what it declares would not rebuild, oci-build builds it with Podman or Docker and reports which runtime and whether it was rootless, and apptainer converts the result to the .sif a cluster runs — plus the offline runtime check the containers doer runs first. It holds two pins that look like pedantry and are not: an unpinned manifest and a mutable image tag both produce containers that run, produce numbers, and do not rebuild.
